NEET-PG cut-off rule under review amid quality concerns

The Union health ministry is reviewing the zero-percentile rule for the NEET-PG entrance exam, considering a shift to a 40th percentile cut-off. This review, prompted by quality concerns, also includes discussions on multi-tiered counselling rounds to fill remaining vacancies. Public health experts are also calling for an overhaul of the NEET system and a greater role for states in the admission process.
